blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Stephen Curry had 34 points, six rebounds, and seven assists, Charles Bassey scored a career-best 19 points to go with eight rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors held off the Phoenix Suns 116-113 in a testy matchup Monday night featuring three technicals and Draymond Green’s ejection. Curry made 11 of 12 free throws, missing his final attempt with five seconds left. He made his initial 51 of the season.
